In addition to terrain that impairs visibility, you might include a jamming field that prohibits ships from communicating with each other, or a sensor scrambler that imposes {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb} checks as the ship's onboard computers struggle to clear out the interference.

entries.name: NPC INITIATIVE
entries: At the beginning of every combat, PC ships typically role group {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative}.  NPC ships may be large in number and/or have huge numbers of NPCs manning them, so a GM should generally determine NPC {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} by rolling for each ship individually as follws.  Roll {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} by making a ship Dexterity check modified by the number given in the {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb} Size Modifier table below.

Encounter Creation and Ship Rating (analogous to Challenge Rating for creatures) needs to be rewritten. It will require a decent amount of maff on my end, so it's not ready yet. For the time being, have your GM use common sense to dictate what is an appropriate encounter.

data.name: Appendix A: Conditions
entries: Conditions alter a starship's capabilities in a varietyof ways and can arise as a result of a power, a starship feature, or some other effect. Most conditions, such as {@condition Blinded|sw5e-sotg|blinded}, are impairments, but a few, such as {@condition Invisible|sw5e-sotg|invisible}, can be advantageous.
A condition lasts either until it is countered or for a duration specified by the effect that imposed the condition.

If multiple effects impose the same condition on a starship, each instance of the condition has its own duration, but the condition's effects don't get worse. A starship either has a condition or doesn't.

Any conditions that reference the ship also apply to any crew members when they take actions involving the ship. For instance, an {@condition Ionized|sw5e-sotg|ionized} ship has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. Consequently, a deployed gunner would have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} with a ship weapon, but not with their own weapons.
The following definitions specify what happens to a ship while it is subjected to a condition.

items: A {@condition Blinded|sw5e-sotg|blinded} ship can't see and automatically fails any {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} that relies on sight or the ship's sensors.
Attack rolls against the ship have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}, and the ship's {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.
A {@condition Disabled|sw5e-sotg|disabled} ship can't communicate with external sources more than 1,000 feet away.
A {@condition Disabled|sw5e-sotg|disabled} ship can't take actions or reactions.
A {@condition Disabled|sw5e-sotg|disabled} ship has 4 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-sotg} Levels.

An {@condition Ionized|sw5e-sotg|ionized} starship has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks}.

An {@condition Invisible|sw5e-sotg|invisible} starship is impossible to see without the aid of powers or a special sense. For the purpose of hiding, the starship is heavily obscured. The starship's location can be detected by any noise it makes or any tracks it leaves.
Attack rolls against the ship have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, and the ship's {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.
A {@condition Shocked|sw5e-sotg|shocked} starship can't take reactions.
On its turn, a crewmembers on a {@condition Shocked|sw5e-sotg|shocked} starship can take either an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, but not both.

entries.name: Slowed
entries: Some abilities, effects, and hazards can lead to a special condition called {@condition Slowed|sw5e-sotg|slowed}. {@condition Slowed|sw5e-sotg} is measured in four levels. An effect can give a ship one or more levels of {@condition Slowed|sw5e-sotg|slowed}, as specified in the effect’s description.

If an already {@condition Slowed|sw5e-sotg|slowed} ship suffers another effect that causes it to be {@condition Slowed|sw5e-sotg|slowed}, its current {@condition Slowed|sw5e-sotg} Level increases by the amount specified in the effect’s description.

An effect that removes {@condition Slowed|sw5e-sotg|slowed} reduces its level as specified in the effect’s description, with all {@condition Slowed|sw5e-sotg|slowed} effects ending if a ship’s {@condition Slowed|sw5e-sotg} Level is reduced below 1.

rows: {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb} reduced to 0, and can’t benefit from any bonus to {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}

items: A {@condition Stalled|sw5e-sotg|stalled} ship is {@condition Disabled|sw5e-sotg|disabled} (see the condition).
Any active features controlled by the ship, such as a Tractor Beam or Gravity Well Projector, automatically end.
The ship automatically fails Strength and Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.
Attack rolls against the ship have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.
A {@condition Stunned|sw5e-sotg|stunned} ship has 4 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-sotg} Levels.
The ship automatically fails Strength and Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.
Attack rolls against the ship have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

entries.name: System Damage
entries: Some special abilities, or when certain conditions are met, cause a ship to sustain a special condition called {@condition System Damage|sw5e-sotg|system damage}. such as and the long-term effects of freezing or scorching temperatures, can lead to a special condition called {@condition System Damage|sw5e-sotg|system damage}. {@condition System Damage|sw5e-sotg|system damage} is measured in six levels. An effect can give a starship one or more levels of {@condition System Damage|sw5e-sotg|system damage}, as specified in the effect's description.

rows: {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}
Hit point maximum, shield point maximum, and shield regeneration rate halved
Ship suffers catastrophic power failure. All primary systems fail.

entries: If a ship with {@condition System Damage|sw5e-sotg|system damage} suffers another effect that causes {@condition System Damage|sw5e-sotg|system damage}, its current level of {@condition System Damage|sw5e-sotg|system damage} increases by the amount specified in the effect's description. A ship suffers the effect of its current level of {@condition System Damage|sw5e-sotg|system damage} as well as all lower levels. For example, a ship suffering level 2 {@condition System Damage|sw5e-sotg|system damage} 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-sotg} Level and {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks}.

An effect that removes {@condition System Damage|sw5e-sotg|system damage} reduces its level as specified in the effect's description, with all {@condition System Damage|sw5e-sotg|system damage} effects (except for "used") ending if a ship's {@condition System Damage|sw5e-sotg|system damage} level is reduced below 1.
Finishing maintenance reduces a ship's {@condition System Damage|sw5e-sotg|system damage} level by 1.

items: A {@condition Tractored|sw5e-sotg|tractored} ship has 4 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-sotg} Levels.
The condition ends if the tractoring ship is {@condition Disabled|sw5e-sotg|disabled} (see the condition).
The condition also ends if an effect removes the {@condition Tractored|sw5e-sotg|tractored} ship from the reach of the tractoring ship or effect.
A used starship's value is reduced by half.

When a deployed crew member on a used starship rolls a 1 on an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, they must make a {@variantrule Destruction Saving Throw|sw5e-sotg}. If the roll is 10 or higher, they succeed. On a failure, the ship suffers 1 level of {@condition System Damage|sw5e-sotg|system damage}.
